patch_description: This crossover keeps the compact fixed-array board representation and efficient in-place tilt/evaluation logic from the current implementation, while restoring the higher-performing inspiration program’s Monte-Carlo policy: its xorshift generator and conservative `{18, 7}` two-level random lookahead sampling. This avoids vector rebuilding and dynamic allocations during search, leaving more runtime margin while preserving the successful randomized expectimax behavior and strip-based clustering evaluation.
